cd tmp1
exec ssg init
cmp stdout ../init_with_current_directory.txt


cd ../tmp2
exec ssg init --force
cmp stdout ../init_with_current_directory.txt


cd ../tmp3
exec ssg init --path test
cmp stdout ../init_with_specified_directory.txt


-- tmp1/_ --
-- tmp2/_ --
-- tmp3/test/_ --


-- init_with_current_directory.txt --
  created   posts
  created   index.md
  created   themes\default\index.html
  created   themes\default\post.html

initialization successful
-- init_with_specified_directory.txt --
  created   test\posts
  created   test\index.md
  created   test\themes\default\index.html
  created   test\themes\default\post.html

initialization successful
